title: Dijkstra's Algorithm
description: Write a Zig program that implements Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm on a weighted graph.
hints: Dijkstra's finds the shortest path from a source to all vertices
Maintain a distance array initialized to INF and a visited set
At each step, pick the unvisited vertex with the smallest distance
Relax edges from the picked vertex to improve distances
